reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate findings on phonon scattering mechanisms in HEAs (P9, P12, P42) and oxygen contamination effects in HfNbTaTiZr (P24) into a single predictive model that explicitly separates lattice from electronic thermal conductivity, a coupling not proposed in any passage. It also transfers the force-constant fluctuation mechanism to a specific refractory alloy with a stated reason (larger atomic differences in BCC HEAs, P42), and defines a quantitative falsification test against low- and high-temperature measurements that resolves the gap between separate transport studies.
